retrievalProfile.description: A side-profile portrait layout featuring a large subject on the right and left-aligned, color-coded sans-serif typography within a thin rectangular frame.
excludeWhen: landscape photography without a human subject

recipe.visualDefinition: A close-up profile portrait of a person with textured hair, occupying the right two-thirds of the frame, contrasted against a dark background on the left where stacked, multi-colored sans-serif text is positioned, partially enclosed in a thin white border.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject profile facing left towards the typography
Text blocks aligned to the left margin
Warm, high-contrast lighting on the subject's face
Thin geometric frame enclosing the primary name
coreInvariants: Thin-stroke rectangular border around the bottom text block

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large-scale profile portrait occupying the right 60% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's illuminated face and the bright yellow text box.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's profile, moves left to the pink title text, then down to the yellow boxed name.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep shadows on the left side provide a canvas for the typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep blacks and dark browns in the background and shadows.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm golden and orange tones on the subject's skin and hair.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Soft pink for the top text and bright yellow for the boxed text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the dark background and the bright, saturated text colors.

composition.relationshipToImage: enclosed in a thin white box

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Uniform typeface family with color-based hierarchy.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, compact grotesque feel of the era.
Provides the necessary weight and verticality for the display text.
Offers a cleaner, more modern mid-century look.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast profile portrait of a person with textured hair, lit with warm golden light from the right, against a dark, shadowy background on the left.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two blocks of left-aligned, uppercase sans-serif text on the left side. The top block should be pink. The bottom block should be yellow and enclosed in a thin white rectangular frame.

verificationChecks: Is the bottom text block enclosed in a thin white box?
Is the lighting on the subject warm and high-contrast?
Are the colors pink and yellow used for the text?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the artist
postGenerationChecks: Text is legible against the dark background
The white box does not touch the subject's face
The profile is clearly defined by light
The color palette remains warm and vintage
recipe.reuseFormula: Profile Portrait + Left-Aligned Stacked Sans-Serif + Color Coding + Thin Geometric Frame
